verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਇਣੁ ਦੁਧ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੂੜ ਵਿਗਾੜੁ ਕਾਂਜੀ ਦੀ ਚੁਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: sach samain dhudh vich kooR vigaaR kaa(n)jee dhee chukhai|

en.bdb: The truth is the rennet in the milk whereas falsehood is like the spoiling vinegar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਣਾ ਨਕੈ ਵਲਿ ਦੁਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: sach bhojan muh khaavanaa ik dhaanaa nakai val dhukhai|

en.bdb: The truth is like eating the food through mouth but the falsehood s painful as if a grain has gone into the nose.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਲਹੁ ਰੁਖ ਰੁਖਹੁ ਸੁ ਫਲੁ ਅੰਤਿਕਾਲਿ ਖਉ ਲਾਖਹੁ ਰੁਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: falahu rukh rukhahu su fal a(n)tikaal khau laakhahu rukhai|

en.bdb: From fruit emerges tree and nom tree the fruit; but if shellac attacks the tree, the latter is destroyed (similarly falsehood decimates the individual).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਉ ਵਰਿਆ ਅਗਿ ਰੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਸਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਗਿ ਬਿੰਦਕੁ ਧੁਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: sau variaa ag rukh vich bhasam karai ag bi(n)dhak dhukhai|

en.bdb: For hundreds of years, the fire remains latent in the tree, but enraged by a small spark, it destroys the ree (similarly the falsehood ever remaining in the mind, ultimately destroys the man).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਕੂੜੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਵੈਦ ਵੇਦਨਿ ਮਨਮੁਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: sach dhaaroo kooR rog hai vin gur vaidh vedhan manmukhai|

en.bdb: The truth is medicine whereas the falsehood is a disease which inflicts the manmukhs who are without physician in the form of Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਥੋਈ ਕੂੜ ਠਗੁ ਲਗੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: sach sathoiee kooR Thag lagai dhukh na gurmukh sukhai|

en.bdb: Truth is companion and the falsehood a cheat who cannot make the gurmukh suffer (because they ever abide in the pleasure of truth).
Falsehood perishes and the truth is ever desired.
